findings.motion: Senate 3rd Reading, SB 1174 Min et al.
findings.note: SB 1174 (Min, 2024) would prohibit a local government from requiring a person to present identification to vote or submit a ballot at a polling place, vote center or other ballot location, as specified; chaptered 2024-09-29. Digital Democracy lists Catherine Blakespear among the 30 'For' votes on the Senate floor (30 for, 8 against).
